title: Capacity triage, forensic telemetry, and scaling rollback plan for Dedicated pools
creator: Marcus Chen
description: Summary: On 2026-03-13 we observed a repeatable capacity shortfall affecting a subset of Dedicated pools serving latency-sensitive routes. Customers saw throttled throughput and elevated tail latency; autoscaler failed to replenish headroom for ~18 minutes in the worst-impacted pools. This ticket consolidates the live triage notes, proposed short-term rollback/containment, forensic telemetry plan, and the longer-term resilience actions we will track in the postmortem.
incident_timeline: 2026-03-13T09:24Z - Alert: Dedicated pool headroom below 10% for pool: eu-west-2-dedicated-4. Alert surfaced from capacity-monitoring rule 'dedicated.headroom.low'.
2026-03-13T09:27Z - Autoscale controller reported repeated scale-up errors: 'quota_exceeded' and 'dealbreaker: kernel selection mismatch'.
2026-03-13T09:30Z - On-call rotation (SRE) started containment runbook; temporarily increased burst capacity for affected customers using reserve tokens.
2026-03-13T09:42Z - Manual rollback: rolled back runtime build runtime-1.21.7 -> runtime-1.21.4 on two affected zones; autoscaler recovered and headroom returned to >30% by 09:50Z.
2026-03-13T10:10Z - Stabilization: routing policy enabled temporary throttle for non-SLA routes; observability dashboards show token-level latency returned to baseline over next 20 minutes.
containment_steps_performed: Enabled reserve headroom policy for top-10 impacted accounts (temporary config override).
Rolled back recent runtime image (runtime-1.21.7 -> runtime-1.21.4) in impacted zones to unblock autoscaler flow.
Applied emergency routing fallback to cheaper model variants for bursty routes to reduce token pressure.
forensic_hypotheses: 1) Kernel selection path regression in runtime-1.21.7 causes per-GPU resource skew, triggering quota_exceeded errors when autoscaler attempts to instantiate new replicas.
2) A change to continuous-batching thresholds increased effective active sequences per GPU, reducing headroom at typical request concurrency patterns.
3) Metric drift in our headroom estimator (recent change to the moving-window) caused delayed detection and inappropriate scale decisions.
forensic_plan: Collect per-GPU allocation traces and kernel selection logs from 2026-03-13T09:00Z - 2026-03-13T11:00Z (ENG: telemetry team tag).
Extract autoscaler event stream and reconcile with cloud provider API responses (quota/limit codes) for failed scale attempts.
Replay representative traffic against runtime-1.21.7 in a staging cluster with identical batch/concurrency settings to reproduce the quota_exceeded condition.
Generate a timeline correlating model variant routing changes, batching metric changes, and headroom estimator outputs to identify the first causal deviation.
kpis_to_capture: cloud provider quota error codes and rate of quota errors
action_items: PRI: Add verbose kernel-selection logs behind a trace flag in runtime (OWNER: Priya Kapoor, ETA: 3d).
SRE: Backfill detailed autoscaler event history and annotate failures with cloud API responses (OWNER: Miguel Alvarez, ETA: 2d).
Telemetry: Add a short-lived high-cardinality view for per-GPU allocation and batch size (OWNER: Linh Tran, ETA: 4d).
Engineering: Create a canary gating step in the rollout pipeline that runs the autoscaler smoke test during image promotion (OWNER: Marcus Chen, ETA: 5d).
Product: Notify impacted customers with a clear timeline and remediation steps; coordinate credits if SLA breached (OWNER: Elena Rossi, ETA: 1d).
Runtime: Add conservative fallback to skip kernel path X if kernel-selector returns an unsupported combo (OWNER: Runtime Team, ETA: 2w).
Console: Surface 'headroom risk' indicator on Dedicated pool dashboard and per-route cost/latency tradeoff selector (OWNER: Diego Park, ETA: 3w).
rollback_strategy: When autoscaler failures spike above threshold and headroom < 15% for >5m, perform targeted runtime rollback to last-known-good image for impacted zones (manual approval required).
Ensure rollout pipeline supports immediate artifact promotion rollback within 10 minutes and provides automated verification hooks for autoscale smoke-tests.
Document a quick CLI operation to re-enable reserve headroom policy for a customer group until a permanent fix lands.
risks_and_tradeoffs: Increasing reserve headroom reduces available capacity for new customers and can increase unit costs — will need to throttle non-SLA routes while reserve is active.
Adding verbose kernel-selection logs increases telemetry volume and storage costs; flagging behind trace prevents sustained cost growth but complicates reproductions later.
Faster rollbacks increase churn and risk of oscillation if root cause persists; we must implement autoscale smoke-tests to reduce false rollbacks.
communication_plan: Post incident summary to #incident-redwood with initial findings and mitigation within 24h (OWNER: Priya Kapoor).
Draft customer-facing timeline and next steps, share with account-sds for impacted large customers (OWNER: Elena Rossi).
Schedule a cross-functional postmortem meeting in 72h with SRE, Runtime, Telemetry, and Product.
